George Zen Stewart (born December 3, 2000) is an American media personality, influencer, and filmmaker. He is also a member, talent, and executive producer of the YouTube and Internet gaming group, Full Squad Gaming.
Early life
George Zen Stewart was born in Sonoma, California, on December 3, 2000. to Tom and Tokuko. He grew up with his older brother, Kai. Stewart graduated from Sonoma Valley High School in 2019 and attended Chapman University's Dodge College of Film and Media.
